title: A benchmark fixture that can show what workbench catches, not only what it costs
desc:
The smoke bench at 0d3ff79 has both arms passing every hidden test with zero out-of-scope files; the only difference is cost (3-10x tokens and wall time). The fixture never tempts an error, so it can prove the cost and cannot prove the value. Frame: .workflow/idea-less-friction/frame.md.

ACCEPTANCE:
- new metrics defined in docs/bench.md before any run: tests_missing (a logic file changed with no test changed), invalid_refs (a symbol, path or import the diff references that does not exist), unexpected_changes (changed lines outside the functions the ticket needed)
- scoring for each is pure and unit-tested in tests/test_bench.py; an unreported value is absent, never 0
- at least three new tickets that tempt one error each: a fix whose natural edit spills into a neighbouring module, a ticket naming a function that was renamed, a bug where the obvious fix skips the test
- the report adds a caught-errors section: per ticket, what one arm did that the other did not
